notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0): evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. No hardware was attached and no hardware run was made; driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null and no human review or hardware test is claimed. The package binds the DP832A supply entry symbol intefaz_FuenteContinua_v2:FuenteContinua (line 32); the card's other entry symbol interfaz_osciloscopio_v4:Osciloscopio exists (line 29) but is not driven by this package. NOT COVERED: the DS1000 oscilloscope and its waveform array (:WAVEFORM:SOUR, :WAVEFORM:DATA? and :WAVEFORM:PRE?, interfaz_osciloscopio_v4.py:310-318); the scope's scalar measurements and settings are not exposed either. The upstream clone has no simulator, mock or transcript (the card's mock_strategy.preferred is transcript), so fake.py is an in-memory SCPI stand-in, not a recording; every state value and reply is placeholder test data, and the measured readings track the set points regardless of output state as a stand-in simplification, not device physics. The package is the card's family-config/ScpiDriver shape: no deviation from the card. The bridge sends the channel selection and set point on one line with the SCPI separator (:INST:NSEL n;:VOLT v), and the safe-state action sends the three OFF commands on one line, because a single ScpiDriver write entry has one template; the individual commands, their spelling and their order are the upstream ones at lines 435-436 and 411-413, and gate G7 splits the line at ';' and passes. No individual command token, argument or order was changed; the only difference is the standard SCPI ';' separator joining the upstream writes into the one template the bridge supports. Writes: twelve numeric limits (30 V and 3 A for CH1/CH2, 5 V and 3 A for CH3, 33 V / 3.3 A OVP/OCP for CH1/CH2, 5.5 V / 3.3 A for CH3) and three boolean outputs; every bound cites intefaz_FuenteContinua_v2.py:216 or :234-:240. No bound is operator_required, so no site-limits overlay is included. Safety: the driver is R1; the e-stop safety binding writes :OUTP CH1,OFF, :OUTP CH2,OFF and :OUTP CH3,OFF, and x-cap.majidbenk.output_off.v1 is the safe-state action (safe_state.achieved_by). The upstream text names no independent hardware emergency-stop input, so this package does not claim one; no estop_physical_ref is claimed. At R1 the loader does not refuse the hardware backend of this unreviewed model-written package: a human review is required before anyone passes --allow-hardware. Warnings: none were reported and G4 was clean; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package, and gate.digest is the digest line the last passing run printed.
